node.statement: Uniform block conditioning: there are universal c_blk>0, B_blk<infinity and e_blk>0 such that, for every datum, every n, and e=rho+epsilon<=e_blk, the assembled map satisfies c_blk||X||<=||gamma_n(X)||<=B_blk||X||. This follows from exact source cornering and quantitative target-corner extraction, not from cancellation-prone triangle estimates alone.
